IF
AddedTo(S_DEN_HalsinBlade_482f56bf-66ed-4d9d-8e1f-9f02b32ed2f6,(CHARACTER)_Player, _)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("DEN_DruidLair_CommentOnBlade")
AND
DB_InRegion(_Player, S_DEN_DruidVault_SUB_f4c22466-5963-4192-b939-f1056f4f806a)
THEN
StartVoiceBark(DEN_DruidLair_VB_ObtainedReward_30f1c286-c927-5097-89af-68d36145a25d, _Player);

PROC
PROC_BlockUseOfItem(_Char,S_MOO_DockVat_000_f503073f-8373-483e-8955-f8b05a627a4f)
AND
DB_Players(_Char)
AND
DB_CantTalk(_Char)
THEN
DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Char,S_MOO_DockVat_000_f503073f-8373-483e-8955-f8b05a627a4f,0);
PROC_PlayCantUseItemAD(_Char);

IF
EnteredTrigger(_Player, S_MOO_HiddenTreasureBox_1ec4fdb0-6913-453a-a87f-ec271ead1ea0)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
DB_MOO_HiddenTreasure_HasMarker(1)
AND
NOT DB_MOO_HiddenTreasure_SkillCheckMade(_Player)
THEN
PROC_TrySkillCheck(_Player, S_MOO_HiddenTreasureWall_46216bdb-1fee-491c-9405-2679f0e44099, "Perception", (DIFFICULTYCLASS)DC_Legacy_Unsaved_1_5f965da8-76c5-a1d4-32bd-0982100f8e10, "MOO_HiddenTreasure_Reveal");
DB_MOO_HiddenTreasure_SkillCheckMade(_Player);

QRY
QRY_SCL_Drider_SelectAfterAmbushHarperDialog((CHARACTER)_Harper, (CHARACTER)_Player, (DIALOGRESOURCE)_Dialog)
AND
NOT DB_DialogName(SCL_Pixie_InsideLantern_bc5adc36-86bf-b782-6e7f-6cc5d12a4abf, _)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(GLO_Pixie_State_InsideLantern_5b43c283-e984-421b-972f-e046e79749ec)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)SCL_Drider_Event_StartCaravanEscort_26062990-9018-4845-a520-d737837fa207)
AND
GetFlag(SCL_Drider_State_HasDriderMoonlantern_a48372d0-609f-48a4-9774-956f6f614c3c, _Player, 1)
THEN
NOT DB_SCL_Drider_StartPixieCall(1);
DB_SCL_Drider_ForceHarpersIntoPixieDialog(1);
DB_SelectedDialog(SCL_Pixie_InsideLantern_bc5adc36-86bf-b782-6e7f-6cc5d12a4abf, S_GLO_DriderMoonlantern_4591d212-8f1b-4b85-880c-dc94f76702f4, _Player);

PROC
PROC_ExecuteInLevel("GLO_Gazette_Paperstacks_AddDailyPapers","CTY_Main_A")
AND
DB_GLO_Gazette_PaperStacks(_Stack)
AND
TemplateIsInInventory(UNI_LOW_BaldursMouth_DailyPaper_5ffe11b1-4949-47cd-ab49-80053db261f9, _Stack, _Count)
AND
_Count < 1
THEN
TemplateAddTo(UNI_LOW_BaldursMouth_DailyPaper_5ffe11b1-4949-47cd-ab49-80053db261f9, _Stack, 1, 0);

IF
CustomBookUIClosed(S_Player_Wyll_c774d764-4a17-48dc-b470-32ace9ce447d, "LOW_CazadorsPalace_CazadorsJournal")
AND
DB_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_BooksReactions((ITEM)S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_CazadorsJournal_74b8042a-2392-40af-a5c1-abaaa14da7cb, _ReactionPAD)
AND
NOT DB_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_BookReactionTried(_ReactionPAD)
AND
QRY_IsInRange((ITEM)S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_CazadorsJournal_74b8042a-2392-40af-a5c1-abaaa14da7cb, S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, 20.0)
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD(_ReactionPAD, S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255);
DB_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_BookReactionTried((DIALOGRESOURCE)_ReactionPAD);
